say:1:1130219001:1.text: Yes, as the leader of Clan Grimmaw, Orson has always had my respect as one of the strongest in the desert.
say:1:1130219001:1.source_cn: 是的，奥格身为黑嚎的族长，他一直是我最尊敬和喜欢的强者。

say:2:1130219002:1.text: Although he didn't defeat Brutus in the last Warsong Festival, he was still brave enough to return to the challenge.
say:2:1130219002:1.source_cn: 虽然之前的他一直没有战胜布鲁特斯，可他仍然坚持参加这届...

say:3:1130219003:1.text: Never say die! That's the most important mentality of a warrior.
say:3:1130219003:1.source_cn: 永不言败——这才是一名勇士最重要的品质！
